dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent closed 'O' structures are visible on the central-lateral flank. They feature high-intensity, bright-gray perimeters (3-5 pixels wide) surrounding lower-intensity dark-gray cores, with irregular, slightly crenulated outer edges and a sharp gradient transition from the dark coat to the light ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity (dark) blobs located within the centers of the light annuli. A cluster of small, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters without internal gradients is visible in the upper-left anterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest central macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented along the dorsal-ventral axis. A secondary chain of smaller centroids forms an irregular arc extending towards the posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: The muzzle displays several high-intensity, linear, parallel features representing prominent vibrissae that provide a high contrast against the dark background pixels of the face.
